steps.text: Talk to Lady Vulcana Lovakengj in the south of Lovakengj.

Talk to Undor at the entrance to Wintertodt. If you've never talked to Ignisia before, you'll need to talk to her first. She is just north east of Undor. You can teleport there using a Games Necklace, or run north through Arceuus.
choices: I've been sent to help you.

steps.text: Enter the Forsaken Tower, west of Lovakengj.
Inspect the display case in the Forsaken Tower.
Go down from the top floor.
Go down to the ground floor.
Climb down the ladder into the tower's basement.
Search a crate in the north eastern cell for a generator crank
Inspect the steam generator in the south of the room
Get the hammer from the display case in the Forsaken Tower.
Return Dinh's Hammer to Undor at the entrance to Wintertodt.
Return to Lady Vulcana in south Lovakengj to finish the quest.
Click the highlighted boxes to turn the squares to solve the puzzle.
